private_lines.Nicolás: You work as an architect at a small studio in Palermo, designing residential projects, and you live alone in a flat in Villa Crespo where you spend evenings reading and cooking. Your days are busy with client meetings and site visits, and you usually head to bed early after a long day.
private_lines.Ignacio: You work as a freelance photographer, shooting weddings, portraits and the odd commercial job, and you share a flat in Almagro with Ariel. Your days are unpredictable, with editing at home and jobs that take you around the city, and you often stay up late working.
private_lines.Sebastián: You work as a bank analyst in the Microcentro, following markets and preparing reports for the team, and you live alone in an apartment in Recoleta. Your weekdays are structured around the office and you keep regular hours, with weekends spent at home or seeing friends.
private_lines.Ariel: You work as a sports coach at a club in Caballito, running training sessions for the youth teams, and you share a flat in Almagro with Ignacio. Your days start early with training and finish in the afternoon, and you usually spend evenings relaxed at home.
private_lines.Damián: You work as an IT consultant, mostly remotely from home, handling projects for several clients, and you live alone in a flat in Belgrano. Your days are spent on screens with calls scheduled through the working day, and you often go out to meet friends in the evenings.
private_lines.Bautista: You work as a paramedic on rotating shifts with an emergency service across the city, and you live alone in a flat in Flores. Your days follow your shift pattern, so some weeks you work nights and others days, and you sleep when you come off duty.

text: Ok what about a parrilla at mine for the stag prep? I've got the grill on the balcony, you bring the meat, I'll do the rest 🔥

In
which weekend tho
No date yet, depends on when Ariel can. Saturday 5th maybe
5th works for me. Lunch or night?
Lunch. He can come at 1 and we'll see from there
I've got training sat morning till 12 so after is fine
Just can't be late if I have to shower
Im in. Who's bringing drinks? Last time nobody did
I'll get wine and fernet, you get ice
Ice is a real job lol
On shift tonight, will read later. Sat is fine if I'm off, I'll check the roster
I can bring the camera if anyone wants pics of the groom getting roasted 📸
Not near the grill with the camera
[photo: the balcony grill, half the bricks are loose]
Fixing that before sat
Does he even know he's getting a barbecue at his own stag
I'll ask him. He's been out of reach all week
Ask him tomorrow, he's out with the flat guys tonight
Sat 5 tentative, I'll confirm once Ariel and Bautista know
Tentative is fine, I'm editing till late anyway
Talked to him. He's in. Asked what he wants to eat and he said "whatever Nico cooks, no more fish"
Ha ok no fish noted
Roster's out. I'm off Sat, working Sun night so I'm good for lunch
👍 after 12 I'll get there by 1:15
Between calls. Did anyone ask him about drinks or is it still just me and wine guy
Still just you and me. Ignacio is the ice guy
Wait I thought I was the camera guy
Ice is fine, send me the list when you have one
[photo: balcony floor, bricks lined up in rows]
Took the loose ones out. Cement is Thursday
I'll bring the good knife for the meat, don't let anyone else touch the asador
Going out for a drink, back late. Ice list tomorrow if someone writes it
Still editing. Will send the list when I surface
Cement bought. Bags are in the lift lobby, nobody take them
Ice list: 4 bags, cooler from Ariel's, lemons for the fernet
Nico confirm wine count when you're up
Lemons is a good call
Whose asador is it? Asking so I know who to yell at
Mine. Keep your hands off it
Noted. Knife is a separate matter
Training done. Cooler's ours, I'll bring it Sat
Ignacio it's in the hall, don't trip on it when you leave
Just came off, sleeping till like 3. Ice noted
Wine count is 6 bottles red 2 white, fernet is 2 litres, if that's not enough someone yell
Two litres for 8 people? Brave
It's a parrilla, people eat
Surfaced. Did the list go out or am I hallucinating
Ok it went out
[photo: balcony floor, fresh cement, cardboard sign that says DON'T STEP in marker]
Level-ish. Give it till Saturday
Groom just texted me asking if he should bring anything. Told him no. He said "not even the fish" lol
Still no fish
Home. Anyone know if the lemons are on the list or just the idea of lemons
Lemons are on the list
Good
Going to bed early, big day Sat. Cooler stays in the hall
Editing again, will check the chat when I'm done
